stories.title: Faulk, Hall of Famer and Southern coach, reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
stories.summary: Marshall Faulk said that in discussing his illness in a podcast appearance Wednesday, "I want to help as many people as I can."

stories.title: Trump criticizes LeBron for not standing still during national anthem
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has accused LeBron James of disrespecting the U.S. after the 76ers star appeared to continue his warmups during the national anthem.

stories.title: Rays opt for Martinez to start World Series over ace Rasmussen
stories.summary: In a bit of a curveball, the Rays will start Nick Martinez, not staff ace Drew Rasmussen, in Game 1 of the World Series against the Brewers.

stories.title: Source: Several teams interested in Colts RB Taylor as Indy mulls next moves
stories.summary: As the Colts plot their next moves after firing GM Chris Ballard, a source told ESPN that several teams would be open to a potential trade for Jonathan Taylor.

stories.title: Panthers make 'big' move in goal as 6-9 Black sets record with debut
stories.summary: The 6-9 Cooper Black is listed 2 inches taller than the goalies who previously held the mark -- Ben Bishop, Ivan Fedotov, Mads Sogaard and Mikko Koskinen.
